body.label: Target
body.html: A sphere of radius 1 centered within 3 units, using mundane trap material.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The area's empty spaces become difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. Choose one visible safe route through it that willing allies can use normally.

surges.html: Extend the safe route 1 space beyond the area.
One enemy already in the area is Slowed 2 on a successful Fortitude check with this roll until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Trap
rider.html: When an enemy voluntarily enters the area, it takes 1 Piercing Damage and is knocked Prone. This triggers once, after its entry.
